question: Do accepted blocking/support/traffic corrections combine into convincing football across the existing controlled contexts?
assessment: Mixed. Four Duo sequences demonstrate useful loaded protection at runner arrival and A044 achieved traffic clearance improves. Eight IZ/WZ Mike access questions and selected postcontact escape/support sequences remain; neither nomination is a proven defect count.

reviewCoverage.scope: All48 paired event/phase/identity/load/velocity review; focused native windows for material changes, not a claim of exhaustive fresh live-film or discarded-stage adjudication.
